modules.name: BreakpointSwitcher

modules.name: ColorPopup

modules.name: Icon

props.name: loadingComponent
props.description: Rendered while the term list or the post's terms are still resolving.

props.name: errorComponent
props.description: Rendered if fetching the terms fails.

modules.name: useCurrentPostType
modules.summary: Returns the post type of the post currently open in the editor.

modules.name: useDebouncedValue
modules.summary: Returns a debounced copy of a value that only updates after a delay of no further changes.

props.name: value
props.description: The value to debounce.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last change before updating.

modules.name: usePrevious
modules.summary: Returns the value a component held on its previous committed render.

props.name: value
props.description: The value to track across renders.

modules.name: useResponsiveAttribute
modules.summary: Reads and writes one logical setting across a breakpoint set, resolving the cascade so a control always has the right own value, inherited value and override state for whichever breakpoint is active.

props.name: attrName
props.description: Base attribute name, e.g. `'columnGap'`.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Currently selected breakpoint id.

props.name: attributes
props.description: The block's attributes.

props.name: setAttributes
props.description: The block's `setAttributes`.

props.name: breakpoints
props.description: The breakpoint set.
